title: Canonical localized comparison for a base K-flat complex
statement: Let $R,A,B,D$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B$ and an $E=A\otimes_R B$-algebra structure on $D$. Let $Q$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose its restriction to $R$ is K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], meaning that its total tensor with every acyclic $R$-complex is acyclic. Suppose $D$ is flat over $E$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For any base-derived tensor cohomology model $M$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] of $Q\otimes_R^L B$, its specified canonical localized comparison $D\otimes_E H^i(Q\otimes_R^L B)\to H^i(Q\otimes_A D)$ is an isomorphism for every integer $i$. No boundedness, projectivity, or localization assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 0A1D, lemma-base-change-tensor, the stalkwise check of Tag 0DJ8 (1); More on Algebra Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change

proof.text: The K-flat R-restriction P of Q computes its derived extension to B with its identity resolution. Thus the universal derived counit is invertible at P. This is the ordinary-module instance of the K-flat derived change-of-rings argument.

The other factors in comparison_eq are the cohomology presentation isomorphism, the derived and homotopy homology factor isomorphisms, and homology of ordinaryIso. They are all invertible. Restriction of scalars to B therefore sends comparison i to an isomorphism. Restriction reflects isomorphisms, because the underlying map is bijective, so comparison i is invertible.

D is E-flat, so scalar extension is exact. Applying it to the cycles and boundaries exact sequences gives the canonical isomorphism from the D-extension of ordinary cohomology to cohomology of the D-extended ordinary complex.

Tensor associativity identifies the extension of E tensor over A Q with D tensor over A Q, commuting with differentials. Its pure-tensor map agrees with ordinaryToLocalized_tmul. Consequently localized_eq and the scalar-extension adjunction identify localizedComparison i with extension of comparison i followed by this exact homology comparison and associativity. Each factor is an isomorphism.

theorem localizedComparison_isIso_of_kFlat_flat
    {R A B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor L
        (((restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
        (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hD : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) D)
    (M : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, IsIso (M.localizedComparison i)
